subject: CNN quantization kickoff — 4-bit training as a serving-cost lever
body:
Hi Bao,

Kicking off the quantization effort. Our open-source quantization codebase (built on tf_cnn_benchmarks) already demonstrates 4-bit fixed-point quantized training — weights and activations both, via the quant_weight_bits=4 / quant_act_bits=4 path with the ReLU-X activation trick. What it's never had is a vetted, supported recipe with quality bars, and meanwhile vision-model serving cost grew 40% year over year.

Goal (Feb 23 – Jun 29): validate 4-bit quantized training on ResNet50-class models against full-precision baselines, characterize the accuracy/cost frontier at 8/4/2 bits, and publish an internal recipe with go/no-go bars for serving teams.

The big validation sweep in June is the one real compute event; everything before is single-node work.

Bao — staffing + the June compute ask, please.

Zofia
